findings.title: Brand name casing inconsistency: 'Internal Search Results' (1×) vs ["'internal search results'"] (1×)
findings.evidence: Page http://127.0.0.1:8899/noindex uses 'Internal Search Results' as the brand name 1 time(s) but also uses ['internal search results'] (1 total minority instances, 50% inconsistency rate). AI assistants that extract brand names from text will encounter multiple forms and may treat them as different entities.

suggested_action.summary: Standardise the brand name to a single canonical form ('Internal Search Results') across all occurrences — currently 1 variant form(s) appear at a 50% inconsistency rate.
